scope: Vowel-final tense first-person endings and negative possibility path isolation

findings.family: Missing buffer y in first-person tense endings
findings.evidence: Production and explicit-root automata reject gelmeliyim/gelmeliyiz/gelmemeliyim/okumalıyız/gelmekteyim/gelmekteyiz at the vowel following y; accept malformed gelmeliim/gelmeliiz/gelmemeliim/okumalıız/gelmekteim/gelmekteiz.
findings.source: Suffix ids70/72 append archiI directly from afterTense, without bufferIfVowel(y).
findings.masking: gelmeliyim/gelmeliyiz are flat-vocabulary protected; other listed correct forms are OOV.

findings.evidence: gelmeyebiliriz/yapmayabilirsiniz/okumayabilirsiniz die at b in explicit root paths and are rejected by production. Ability rule is verbRoot-only; negation continuation lacks this route.
findings.limit: Positive ability controls also have a separate known derived aorist metadata limitation; do not use those as fully working morphology controls.

impact: Coverage/overgeneration defects confirmed, but no incorrect text changes in the 16 center-touch followup runs; malformed literal controls were preserved.
validation: Two targeted diagnostic tests passed; no simulator verification.
next_step: Probe nominal/stative first-person paradigms and ensure morphological false acceptance is not confused with observed text corruption.
